# Named N-API contracts

<!-- Generated by cargo run -p xtask -- contracts. Do not edit. -->

This is the canonical inventory of Rust bridge declarations in `crates/ability` and
`crates/plugin-*`, across all feature configurations (excluding test-only modules).
Both macro declarations and handwritten `BridgeNapiType` implementations are included.
This is not a JSON protocol. ArkTS must use these exact ABI names.

Regenerate with `cargo run -p xtask -- contracts`; CI checks with
`cargo run -p xtask -- contracts --check`. Action routing, lifecycle rules and
platform failure policies remain in the [plugin standard](plugin-development-standard.md).

shown. Handwritten native-object conversions (for example `ResourceManagerRef`)
are defined by their linked source, not by an invented object layout.
